name: Portable Fire Telephone Handset heavy duty (Replaces EVC301/HS)
summary: The EVC301/PH A portable fire telephone handset designed for use in conjunction with a series of EVC301/JP Jack Plates on the SigTEL emergency voice communication systems.
description: Includes a flexible 1.5m coiled lead c/w a 1/4” jack plug.
When plugged into an EVC301/JP Jack Plate the handset EVC301/PH will call the SigTEL master controller from where a two-way speech channel can be opened and instructions communicated.
Multiple jack plates can be connected to a single SigTEL Master Controller line in stairwells, etc.
Designed for use in regions where roaming handsets are required.
Facilitates reliable two-way communication in an emergency between a permanently manned control room and key points of a site.

specs.label: Approvals/certifications
specs.value: Designed for use in regions where roaming handsets are required

specs.label: Supply/operating voltage
specs.value: 11V DC derived from a compatible SigTEL Master Controller (drops to 6 V DC when in use).

specs.label: Activation current
specs.value: 25mA (current draw when handset is in use).

specs.label: Indicators
specs.value: When the operator in the control room calls the outstation, a pulsed ringing tone sounds at the outstation.

specs.label: Product dimensions (mm)
specs.value: 180 H x 55 W x 40 D mm.
